outcome: cerebral ventricular size (ventricular index, anterior horn width, thalamo-occipital distance)
cohort: The study included 244 neurologically healthy preterm neonates born at 23 0/7-26 6/7 weeks of gestational age.
finding: Longitudinal percentile charts were established for cerebral ventricular size measurements (ventricular index, anterior horn width, and thalamo-occipital distance) in extremely premature infants.
